title: Protein Degradation: Ubiquitin–Proteasome and Lysosomal Pathways
method: Unicode lexical count from actual saved HTML p.teaching-prose paragraphs, excluding headings, tables, SVG, captions, exercises, answers, revision, references and UI. Article total includes supplementary text and visible SVG labels, excluding title/desc and buttons.
scientific_checks: Revised CSIR Unit 3.C printed p.4, separate CSIR and archived MP SET p.3 screenshots checked; separate NET/SET do not name degradation explicitly in 3.C.

Reviewed degradation vs denaturation, kinetics and dilution, reticulocyte conjugation experiments, E1 adenylation and E2 thioesters, RING vs HECT/RBR, ubiquitin linkage and non-proteasomal signals; proteasome architecture, gate, initiation segment, unfolding, deubiquitination and cleavage; lysosomal pH, sorting, macroautophagy and CMA, flux, ERAD, ClpXP, APC/C, N-degrons, HIF/VHL and auxin/TIR1, pulse-chase and controls.
Second editorial pass strengthened 12 analytical distractors and replaced redundant plot with pulse-chase diagram.

academic_self_review.method: Separate internal author review, not external peer review.

limitations: Source records and accessible abstracts/reviews checked, not all full papers.
Static HTML/SVG validation; interactive browser/mobile and comprehensive accessibility tests not performed.
New slug follows repository title convention.
